name: Flores
blurb: Recent online discussions regarding Flores focus heavily on seismic activity, including a M7.7 earthquake and subsequent aftershocks in the Flores Sea region. Travelers also note scenic local landmarks like Mount Inerie, an active volcano likened by locals to Mount Fuji.

positive: Appreciation for the symmetry of Mount Inerie
negative: Devastating earthquake activity and subsequent aftershocks
Frequent moderate and weak tremors in the Flores Sea region
